description_good_justification: README describes the project purpose and user-facing result: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/blob/main/README.md
interact_justification: README explains how to obtain/use the project, report bugs or enhancements, contribute changes, and report security issues: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/blob/main/README.md
contribution_justification: The contribution process is documented, including branch, test, pull-request, and required-check steps: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: Contribution quality and testing requirements are documented in CONTRIBUTING.md: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
floss_license_justification: Project source is released under the MIT License: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/blob/main/LICENSE
floss_license_osi_justification: MIT is an OSI-approved open-source license; the repository declares MIT: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/blob/main/LICENSE
license_location_justification: The license text is stored in the repository root LICENSE file: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/blob/main/LICENSE
documentation_basics_justification: README documents prerequisites, local startup, verification, and links to operational/security documentation: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/blob/main/README.md
documentation_interface_justification: Public behavior and data interfaces are documented in docs/PUBLIC_SITE_SPEC.md and docs/data-contract.md: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/tree/main/docs
sites_https_justification: Repository and public deployment use HTTPS: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site and https://dotitao-moments.onrender.com/
discussion_justification: The public GitHub repository uses Issues and Pull Requests for discussion of bugs, enhancements, and proposed changes: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/issues
maintained_justification: The public repository is active, not archived, and receives current commits and automated verification: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site
repo_public_justification: Source and history are publicly available on GitHub: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site
repo_track_justification: Git tracks project source and change history in the public repository: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/commits/main/
repo_interim_justification: Intermediate changes are retained in the public Git history and merged through pull requests rather than only publishing release snapshots: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/commits/main/
repo_distributed_justification: The project uses Git, a distributed version-control system: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site
version_unique_justification: Each deployed project state is uniquely identified by its immutable Git commit SHA on main; the operations workflow verifies exact target SHAs: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md
release_notes_justification: The primary result is a continuously deployed static site from main rather than separately distributed versioned releases; OpenSSF explicitly permits N/A for this continuous-deployment case. Deployment operations are documented here: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md
release_notes_vulns_justification: The project uses continuous deployment rather than separate user releases, so release-note vulnerability listings are not applicable. Vulnerability handling is documented in SECURITY.md: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/blob/main/SECURITY.md
report_process_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md directs ordinary bug reports and enhancement requests to GitHub Issues and states what information to provide: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
report_tracker_justification: GitHub Issues is the public issue tracker: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/issues
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues keeps issue reports and responses publicly archived: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/issues
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md documents the vulnerability reporting process: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md provides GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting rather than requiring a public issue: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md targets initial acknowledgement within 7 days, which is stricter than the OpenSSF passing requirement of responding within 14 days: https://github.com/misaka310/video-highlights-site/blob/main/SECURITY.md
